text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In preparation for the Victoria Mile, 
we had been gradually increasing the 
intensity 
of her training, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! 
Kh...!
choice_data_list:
(I guess things still haven't fully 
returned to how they were...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether due to the lingering effects of 
her injury or the way her 
muscles developed during her hiatus... 
running with her old form 
seemed visibly uncomfortable for her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm alright. But... 
I'm sorry, that must have looked quite 
awkward...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be that I need to change my 
running form?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though track conditions and tactical 
scenarios can influence it, 
a runner's innate form rarely changes 
easily. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact came back to win. 
To return stronger than before, she needed 
to adopt 
the form that best suited her right now.
choice_data_list: Let's build a whole new running form!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A new form... 
Hehe, that reminds me of my entrance exam.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back then, you helped me refine 
my running form as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I watched footage of Daring 
Tact and adjusted 
her form to match what I believed was 
ideal. But now—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
Let's create our brand new form...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
choice_data_list: How was your stride length just now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... it felt like my foot was 
slipping slightly. 
...Perhaps my push-off isn't biting into 
the ground like it used to.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It might be better to keep my initial 
strides 
a bit shorter and tighter at the start.
choice_data_list: Let's try that out on an 800m run next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By constantly calibrating with Daring 
Tact's sensations, 
we gradually shaped a form that fit her 
current self best. And then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—...Ngh, here I go! 
Huuhhhhh...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the start, Daring Tact broke into 
rapid, tight strides. 
It differed somewhat from her past style, 
which looked like 
soaring with grand wings spread wide, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was nimble, picked up speed 
effortlessly, and adapted well 
to any situation—it was a form built to 
survive.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, just now...! 
That felt so easy to run in!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's do a mock race for our 
final check.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We gathered some helpers and hastily 
organized a mock race 
over the same 1600m distance as the 
Victoria Mile, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't stretch out enough at the 
end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact finished in 6th place. 
There was barely any margin to 1st, which 
was quite a feat 
considering her injury, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To truly complete this "new running form," 
perhaps there is still something missing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If only I can find that missing piece, 
I know I'll be able to deliver a 
performance I can be proud of...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I have a favor to ask. 
Would you permit me to spend a few days 
secluded in the mountains?
choice_data_list: Is that... to find whatever's missing?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, I can't say for certain 
that it will.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
However... nature has always given me 
so many realizations up until now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
About life, about cycles... I'm sure it 
might teach me 
what I need this time as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if she's used to the mountains, she's 
only just recovered. 
If she were to suffer another injury on 
top of this...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! 
Why don't you leave that to me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Daring Heart...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
With me around, I can keep a proper eye on 
Tact 
and help her out no matter what happens.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I won't let her overdo it, absolutely not. 
I promise. So... what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart, with her deep familiarity 
with the mountains, 
was certainly far better suited for this 
than I was. 
...Besides, I sensed she had some kind of 
purpose in mind.
choice_data_list:
...Alright. Just make sure you don't push 
yourself too hard.

...Alright. Just promise you won't overdo 
it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! 
I'll go borrow the strength of nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! 
Shall we have lunch here today?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey Tact, 
those berries over there... are they 
mulberries?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they are! 
They're very nutritious berries. 
We have permission, so let's forage some.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, leave it to me! 
How about baking a mulberry cake?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, they spoil quite quickly, so that 
might be difficult. 
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...Being with Daring Heart brings such 
peace to my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... is that needed "something" 
really nowhere... not to be found here?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Tact. 
I found a flat clearing over there. Care 
to join me?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—All right! 
Shall we run?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"There are hardly any obstacles, so you'll 
be fine. 
Just two furlongs—care for a match race?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take the lead. 
That suits your style just fine, doesn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. 
Then I shall pursue you."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(What's gotten into Daring Heart? 
A match race all of a sudden...?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—Tact, let's see 
those survival skills! 
............Haaahhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...! 
This pressure...?!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(This isn't the Daring Heart I know! 
This presence, this sensation is...—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(—Like a cornered beast hunted by a 
stronger predator, 
yet baring its fangs in a desperate last 
stand... 
The raw ferocity of survival!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Frantic, gritty... and utterly 
breathtaking. 
A relentless tenacity for life—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Heart... 
You are...—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Tact. You truly are magnificent. 
A formidable horsegirl who achieved an 
unbelievable feat."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That was earned by your own power. Your 
own greatness. 
Compared to that, what little I have to 
give... 
might amount to next to nothing."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... now is my cue. 
Because what you lack right now, I have in 
spades."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...! 
Could that be...—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The will to survive— 
The unyielding heart to stay alive."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—I never won the Triple Tiara. 
I was left eating the dust of my peers 
again and again..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yet in this merciless world... 
I kept on surviving. Do you know why?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've got this 
'daring heart'—a brave, fearless soul."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"This unbending spirit that takes pride in 
being covered in mud... 
is my weapon. The very reason I kept 
surviving..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Tact, now that you've changed the way you 
fly... 
you might find yourself caught up in low 
branches 
you never had to notice before."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"When that happens, struggle. Toward the 
light my heart shines for you— 
Even if you're battered, even if you 
bleed... 
Struggle, and keep on flying!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Daring Heart...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Why do you give 
so much of your heart to me?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Why go this far...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Because it was admiration for me 
that started you down this path."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You've brought me so much immense joy. 
And that's why, Tact—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —You can bloom in full glory once again.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(A warm strength flows into me. 
...So this is the wellspring of Daring 
Heart's power.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(This is—what I was lacking. 
The resolve to claim victory from the 
position of a 'chaser'.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much. 
With this, I am whole."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I will adapt to any environment and 
survive. 
Together with this 'daring heart'—"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Awakened '<itemname>'

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Now, I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Victoria Mile. 
Having safely reached her comeback stage— 
Daring Tact's expression was resolute and 
dignified.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Next up is this horsegirl! Striking 
character, 
undeniable talent, and overflowing charm— 
an up-and-coming idol horsegirl—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...While I was resting, so many 
formidable new rivals have stepped up.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Right now, I am the one... 
chasing after them.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...Even so, I will survive. 
I know I can, because...)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—And next, Daring Tact! 
Making a glorious comeback from injury, 
she returns to the turf!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Listen to that resounding applause! 
So many have been eagerly awaiting the 
return 
of our Triple Tiara horsegirl...!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"We're so glad to have you back! 
What kind of performance will she show us 
for this brand-new beginning? We can 
hardly wait!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...It's all right. I... can do this.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Because I have this daring heart— 
and everyone cheering me on!"
